title: persistence-data-postgres v1.0.0 blueprint on the shelf with six Node-only probes against a live postgres:17-alpine container and a sample-app fixture
summary: T-1 shelf-blueprint track of the ratified infra round 5 spec (2026-09-06, section 5.1): the persistence-data-postgres v1.0.0 blueprint on the shelf. Ships 26 contributions in the 7 REQ / 10 US 27101-27110 / 4 TAC 2801-2804 / 5 ADR 2801-2805 groups per spec section 5.1, six Node-only probes under blueprints/persistence-data-postgres/contributions/probes/ (facade-round-trip, migration-apply, prepared-statement-scan, transaction-atomicity, recovery-restore-round-trip, pool-posture-smoke) with matching run-<probe-name>.mjs shims that write per-blueprint reports at .rcf/reports/blueprints/persistence-data-postgres/<probe-name>.json, and a dependency-free sample-app fixture at packages/rcf-lite/test/fixtures/infra-postgres/ with docker-compose declaring postgres:17-alpine, three toy forward-only migrations, src/store.mjs realising the facade as sole reader of pg, src/recovery.mjs realising the scheduled export runner via pg_dump, package.json with pg as runtime dep, and a README naming docker and podman incantations plus induced-failure switches. Declares capabilities [relationalStore], suggestedCompanions logging and errorHandling, providesRoles absent, requiresAppliedCapabilities absent. Contributes ADR-2801 and ADR-2802 as scope:global on persistenceStore and migrationDiscipline reused from persistence-data-sqlite and persistence-data-d1 so composition with either surfaces a DELIBERATE conflict per the round-2 pattern. Extends packages/rcf-lite/docs/blueprint-authoring.md section 6a table with a relationalStore row per spec section 5.6; appends one shelf-registry row for persistence-data-postgres at 27101-27899 / 28xx to every shipped blueprint's docs/topics.md. Reserves the round-6 Hyperdrive v1.1.0 adapter slot at ADR-2801 by keeping the driver reference opaque at the facade boundary per spec section 5.7. None of the six probes carry accountBound:true; Postgres is local-first per Baz decision 8.
